comment: Generated by `cd proto/go && go test ./solana/zsescrow -run TestOpenOfferVectors -update`. Each case is an open offer's message and the spec its payer holds; verdict is "ok" or the field slug of the check that refuses it. source "fixture" is the program's own transaction of that name in solana_tx_vectors.json; "built" is one built here.

cases.name: open
cases.about: the open offer: compute budget, the payer's TransferChecked into the node's vault, open with grace 0

cases.name: open_extra_instruction
cases.about: a second copy of the payer's TransferChecked, same vault and amount, after open

cases.name: open_wrong_vault
cases.about: the transfer goes to an account that is not the node's vault

cases.name: open_wrong_amount
cases.about: the transfer moves one unit less than open's max_price

cases.name: open_extra_signer
cases.about: the header requires a third signature, by a key no instruction references

cases.name: open_approve
cases.about: an Approve of the payer's ATA to another key, before the transfer

cases.name: open_payer_writable
cases.about: only the allowlisted instructions, but the transfer names the payer's wallet as a writable signer, so the header grants the payer a write lock

cases.name: open_foreign_program
cases.about: a System Program transfer from the node's own key to another account after open: a top-level program outside ComputeBudget, SPL Token and this program, with the payer's privileges unchanged

cases.name: open_duplicate_compute_budget
cases.about: a second SetComputeUnitLimit

cases.name: open_grace_nonzero
cases.about: open names its own grace instead of 0, which the program accepts within the configured bounds

cases.name: open_close_account
cases.about: a CloseAccount of the payer's ATA, emptied by the transfer, its rent to another key, after open

cases.name: open_v0_lookup_table
cases.about: the open offer as a v0 message, the vault and the mint loaded from a lookup table

cases.name: open_v0
cases.about: the open offer as a v0 message with no lookup table

cases.name: open_fold_settle
cases.about: the open offer with a settle_cooperative of the payer's previous ticket folded in before the transfer; the claim's amount, usage and receipt_digest are the receipt's

cases.name: open_fold_settle_wrong_amount
cases.about: as open_fold_settle, but the claim charges more than the receipt

cases.name: open_fold_settle_wrong_digest
cases.about: as open_fold_settle, but the claim's receipt_digest differs from sha256(receipt) in one byte

cases.name: open_fold_settle_wrong_usage
cases.about: as open_fold_settle, but the claim's output_units are one more than the receipt's

cases.name: open_fold_settle_wrong_ticket
cases.about: as open_fold_settle, with the same receipt and claim, but the settle names another open ticket of the same payer than the one the receipt is for

cases.name: open_set_authority
cases.about: a SetAuthority moving the payer's ATA to another owner, after open

cases.name: from_the_builders
cases.about: the offer a node composes from the builders, as the payer rebuilds it

cases.name: no_compute_budget
cases.about: the transfer and open alone

cases.name: truncated
cases.about: the open offer's message with its last byte cut

cases.name: fee_payer_not_the_node
cases.about: open signed and paid for by another key

cases.name: payer_not_a_signer
cases.about: the transfer's authority not marked a signer, so only the node signs

cases.name: another_payer
cases.about: the open offer judged by a payer it does not name

cases.name: another_ticket
cases.about: open names a ticket id the payer did not reserve

cases.name: another_expiry
cases.about: open names an expiry one second past the ticket's

cases.name: both_amounts_raised
cases.about: the transfer and open agree on one unit more than the payer reserved

cases.name: transfer_from_another_account
cases.about: the transfer draws from a token account other than the payer's

cases.name: transfer_other_decimals
cases.about: the transfer names 9 decimals

cases.name: heap_frame
cases.about: a RequestHeapFrame among the compute budget

cases.name: compute_budget_long
cases.about: a SetComputeUnitLimit with a byte past its u32

cases.name: compute_budget_short
cases.about: a SetComputeUnitLimit a byte short of its u32

cases.name: compute_budget_tag_alone
cases.about: a SetComputeUnitPrice with its tag and no price

cases.name: compute_budget_with_an_account
cases.about: a SetComputeUnitLimit naming the payer's token account

cases.name: compute_budget_after_transfer
cases.about: a compute-budget instruction between the transfer and open

cases.name: no_transfer
cases.about: open with no transfer before it, so the payer signs nothing and is no signer

cases.name: transfer_twice
cases.about: two copies of the transfer before open

cases.name: transfer_after_open
cases.about: the transfer after open

cases.name: open_twice
cases.about: open, then open again

cases.name: token_no_data
cases.about: a token instruction with no data before the transfer

cases.name: open_short
cases.about: open without its last account

cases.name: open_discriminator_only
cases.about: open's discriminator with no arguments

cases.name: claim_beside
cases.about: a claim of the payer's ticket after open

cases.name: ack_beside
cases.about: the payer's ack of a claim, after open

cases.name: fold_without_a_ticket
cases.about: the folded offer judged by a payer with no ticket to settle

cases.name: fold_readonly_fallback
cases.about: the folded settle passing the treasury's USDC account read-only, which the program uses only for a refund the payer's account can't take

cases.name: fold_writable_fallback
cases.about: the folded settle passing the treasury's USDC account writable, accepted: the program forfeits a refund the payer's account can't take on every ending

cases.name: fold_treasury_of_another
cases.about: the folded settle passing another key's USDC account where the treasury's goes

cases.name: fold_treasury_unknown
cases.about: the folded settle passing the treasury's USDC account, judged by a payer that names no treasury

cases.name: fold_after_transfer
cases.about: the folded settle between the transfer and open

cases.name: fold_at_another_node
cases.about: the folded settle judged by a payer whose ticket is at another node

cases.name: fold_receipt_of_another_ticket
cases.about: the folded settle and its receipt both name a ticket other than the payer's previous one

cases.name: fold_receipt_ticket_unpadded
cases.about: the receipt spells the payer's ticket id without base64 padding

cases.name: fold_no_receipt
cases.about: the payer's previous ticket with no receipt

cases.name: fold_five_accounts
cases.about: the folded settle cut off before its rent payer

cases.name: fold_short
cases.about: the folded settle without its last account

cases.name: fold_discriminator_only
cases.about: settle_cooperative's discriminator with no claim

cases.name: fold_receipt_past_u32
cases.about: the payer's receipt has ttft, decode and aux count each past a u32, which a claim's u64 fields carry

cases.name: fold_claim_ttft_truncated
cases.about: the folded claim carries the receipt's ttft cut to a u32

cases.name: fold_claim_decode_truncated
cases.about: the folded claim carries the receipt's decode time cut to a u32

cases.name: fold_claim_aux_truncated
cases.about: the folded claim carries the receipt's aux count cut to a u32
